text: I'd like you to make a poster with a cream background. I'm in a bit of a slow-weekend mood, which is why this idea appeals to me. The poster should be square, with the dark brown headline 'SLOW SUNDAY' centred near the top. There should be a little illustrated coffee cup in the bottom half. Please leave plenty of space around the headline, and don't include any other words. I always end up over-explaining these things because I worry I'll forget to mention something.
